headlines.title: Deliverect Earns Premier Status in Uber Partner Network
headlines.summary: Deliverect, the global restaurant technology company that connects digital ordering channels with in-store operations and orchestrates delivery across the restaurant ecosystem, has earned Premier Status in the Uber Partner Network.

headlines.title: Uber Technologies Targets 10,000 Driverless Vehicles by 2028 Amid $10 Billion AV Push
headlines.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) is pursuing growth in its core ride-hailing and delivery businesses while investing in autonomous vehicles, Chief Financial Officer Balaji Krishnamurthy said at a media and telecom conference.

headlines.title: Grab vs. Uber Technologies: Which Gig Economy Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Grab's superapp model and Uber's 70-country scale pull in opposite directions, and their cash flow profiles tell very different stories.

headlines.title: Uber Riders in Vegas Can Now Get Driverless Zoox Robotaxi
headlines.summary: Uber Technologies Inc. on Monday launched Zoox robotaxi rides through its app in Las Vegas. The company also announced separate partnerships to expand electronics delivery in Canada and accelerate electric vehicle adoption in India.

headlines.title: Learn Why The Bull Case For Kohl's (KSS) Could Change Following Uber Eats Delivery Launch
headlines.summary: Uber Technologies announced a nationwide partnership that puts Kohl's assortment from more than 1,100 stores on Uber Eats for on demand and scheduled delivery, including apparel, home goods and select Sephora at Kohl's beauty products. The tie up gives Kohl's another way to reach value focused shoppers who might be cutting back on trips to physical stores but still want convenient access to everyday essentials and gifting categories.

description: Uber Technologies, Inc. develops and operates proprietary technology applications in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company operates through three segments: Mobility, Delivery, and Freight. The Mobility segment connects consumers with a range of transportation modalities, such as ridesharing, carsharing, micromobility, rentals, public transit, taxis, and other modalities; and offers riders in a variety of vehicle types, as well as financial partnerships products and advertising services. The Delivery segment allows consumers to search for and discover restaurants to grocery, alcohol, convenience, and other retailers, as well as order a meal or other items, and either pick-up at the restaurant or have it delivered; and provides Uber direct, a white-label delivery-as-a-service for retailers and restaurants, as well as advertising services. The Freight segment manages transportation and logistics networks, which connects shippers and carriers in digital marketplace, including carriers upfronts, pricing, and shipment booking; and offers on-demand platform to automate logistics end-to-end transactions for small-and medium-sized businesses to global enterprises. Uber Technologies, Inc. has strategic partnership with Mews to embed ride booking, real-time tracking and integrated billing directly into the Mews platform. The company was formerly known as Ubercab, Inc. and changed its name to Uber Technologies, Inc. in February 2011. Uber Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
